findings: The opt-in path constructs the declared 263-channel order: 112 raw channels, 99 canonical event channels, then the sequence-local causal i1 gather at the last ev_i0px event, with row zero forced as the initial event.

Tied branches reconstruct pre-normalization values from normalized input and fitted mean/std; the main projection receives normalized input. One shared encoder module serves i0, i1, and lead branches; residual projections are zero initialized and added before GELU.

Per-encode-call deltas reset at chunk boundaries while the appended lead is assembled over the complete sequence before chunking, consistent with the pinned archived-source interpretation and its stated compatibility limit.

The fixed tiedlead profile rejects incompatible input/model modifiers and nonzero family-head weight. The default GRU path remains opt-out. Existing family-head-at-zero and alpha-zero label-only objective controls remain separate work and are not claimed here.

Training source identity and tiedlead-specific provenance bind the implementation/profile inputs; README and validation correctly avoid claiming historical runtime identity or measured production behavior.
